topicTitle: Immunization, Cold Chain, National Immunization Schedule, and AEFI
alt: Shake test comparing a suspect aluminium-adsorbed vaccine vial with a frozen-thawed control to detect freeze damage
caption: Shake test: used for aluminium-adsorbed freeze-sensitive vaccines (DPT, Td, TT, Hepatitis B, pentavalent, PCV). Shake a suspect vial and a frozen-thawed control from the same batch for 10 to 15 seconds, then watch sedimentation for 30 minutes. Pass: the suspect vial stays cloudy longer than the control. Fail: the suspect vial sediments as fast as or faster than the control; discard it.

topicTitle: Respiratory Infections - Part B (Influenza, Acute Respiratory Infections, Pneumonia, Tuberculosis)
alt: Natural history of tuberculosis from droplet-nucleus exposure through latent infection to active disease and onward transmission
caption: Natural history of tuberculosis: inhalation of droplet nuclei from a sputum-positive case leads to infection (tuberculin conversion in 3 to 6 weeks). About 90 percent of infected people contain the bacilli as latent infection. Five to 10 percent develop clinical disease in a lifetime. An untreated infectious pulmonary case can infect 10 to 15 people in a year. Effective treatment cuts infectivity by about 90 percent within 48 hours. HIV is the strongest risk factor for progression from infection to disease.
